scope: Additive Royal Champion TH18 wall-crossing base-movement contract. Seeking Shield, equipment, pets, Hero Banner defense and visual jump animation remain excluded.
game_version: The original Royal Champion release description is still the consulted public source for the wall-crossing capability. No current client tick-level jump transition specification was published.

sources.title: A Fourth Hero Comes To The Home Village!
sources.limitations: Confirms that the Royal Champion can jump across walls to reach defenses. It does not specify jump wind-up, landing location, collision boundary, retargeting or animation timing.

jumps_walls.note: The shared Core pathfinding ignores Walls when routing to the selected defense. This is a deterministic movement adaptation, not a claim of frame-accurate jump animation or collision.

support.note: Core, Headless, Viewer and RL use the same defense-priority wall-bypass path. Seeking Shield, equipment, pets, Hero Banner defense and exact visual transition remain unavailable.

changed_values.previous_state: Base attack was available but documented wall crossing was not enabled in Core.
changed_values.replacement: The Royal Champion now uses the shared deterministic wall-bypass route to reach defenses.
changed_values.justification: The first-party Hero description directly establishes the capability. Existing pathfinding and state serialization provide a shared deterministic route.

items: jump wind-up, landing and collision geometry
same-tick target loss and retarget ordering while crossing
projectile speed, launch and impact timing
source-verified Viewer jump animation and asset placement

conclusion: Royal Champion wall crossing is a source-traced partial shared Core movement integration. The Viewer does not invent a jump animation to compensate for Core geometry.
